name: kaikanakku
description: KaiKanakku — a local-first personal expense tracker with SMS auto-parsing for Indian bank/UPI transactions. All data stays on-device.
author: KaiKanakku Contributors

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-svgs.mjs && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:web: export VITE_ROUTER_BASE=/kaikanakku && node scripts/generate-svgs.mjs && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:cap: export VITE_NO_PWA=true && node scripts/generate-svgs.mjs && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/generate-android-assets.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleRelease
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:cap && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:web: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
